plan_a: Red burn: the plan is simple and fast — point every burn spell (Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, Fireblast) at the opponent's FACE and deploy one-drops (Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel) for extra reach. Price of Progress punishes nonbasics. Only kill their creatures if you'd otherwise die. Count lethal every turn; you usually win by turn 4 — race, don't durdle.
plan_b: Elves combo-aggro: flood the board with mana-elves (Heritage Druid, Nettle Sentinel, Fyndhorn/Llanowar Elves, Quirion Ranger), chain them into Glimpse of Nature to draw your deck, then finish with a huge Craterhoof Behemoth overrun or Green Sun's Zenith / Natural Order for it. Wirewood Symbiote + Visionary generate value. Gaea's Cradle makes explosive mana. Go wide, then go tall and swing.
